dispositions.change: ui.chat.pickers.usage_view.resets_in: 后重置 → 距重置
dispositions.evidence: usage-view.tsx:289,349 place the label before the countdown; rendered sample reads 距重置 3h24m in both the row and the binding-block column.

dispositions.change: 代码内存 → 代码记忆 in code_memory and its six sibling sentences (code_memory_starts_when_you_send_your_first_message, no_code_memory_yet, this_chat_cannot_read_code_memory, the_backend_did_not_answer…, update_the_backend_to_read_code_memory, this_app_can_read_code_memory…); 内存 stays the RAM term elsewhere.
ui.canvas.inline_edit.edit_instructions: 编辑说明 → 编辑指令
ui.canvas.wysiwyg_markdown_editor.checklist: 核对清单 → 任务列表
dispositions.evidence: Both audits asked for the same fix with different nouns; 任务列表 was chosen because the same toolbar already says 项目符号列表 and 编号列表, so the 列表 family keeps the control set coherent, while 清单 appears nowhere else in this toolbar.

dispositions.change: ui.canvas.file_viewer.file_no_longer_exists_at: 文件已不存在于{value} → {value}处的文件已不存在
dispositions.evidence: Both audits rejected the 于 calque. The path-fronted form from T-C02 was chosen over 文件已不在以下位置：{value}: it reads as one clause, needs no colon before a long path, and mirrors the sibling file_no_longer_exists toast.

advisories: ui.chat.pickers.usage_view_model.not_reported stays 未报告 although it is a tally label: the same key also backs NOT_REPORTED() (usage-view-model.ts:518), the row value shown when a vendor reports no number, where a classifier would be wrong. The tally therefore ends with one bare status (2 未报告).

The callers still append ASCII punctuation and raw English tokens in places the audit recorded as code-level advisories (mediaLabel "image"/"asset", backend loop status, the trailing "." after the session-panel sentence). This round is catalogue-only and does not edit code.
conflict_summary: checklist: 任务清单 (ZH-CANVAS-3) vs 任务列表 (T-C04) — chose 任务列表 (toolbar sibling 列表 family).
file_no_longer_exists_at: 文件已不在以下位置：{value} (ZH-CANVAS-4) vs {value}处的文件已不存在 (T-C02) — chose T-C02.
records_run_from: 记录时间范围： (ZH-PICKERS-3) vs 记录起始时间 (T-P05) — chose ZH-PICKERS-3 (the value is a range).
no_usage_reports: 请登录… (ZH-PICKERS-5) vs 登录一个… (T-P04) — chose T-P04 (请 is reserved for "please").
install wording: 当前安装 (ZH-UPDATES-1) vs 当前安装实例 (T-U01) — chose 当前安装实例 (matches 安装实例 adopted for T-P06 in this round).
